{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Indigestion''' was a common complaint among many [[Species/Legends|species]], which frequently consisted of an unsettled or uncooperative digestive tract. Although usually considered undesirable, in some cases it proved life-saving, namely when [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] was rejected by the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|What is indigestion? Who is Einstein? Artoo, really? Before you ask me who is H.G. Wells, I will help your education with a simple explanation of bells.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] introducing the song "[[Christmas in the Stars|Bells, Bells, Bells]]" to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Christmas in the Stars">''[[Christmas in the Stars]]''</ref>}}
The [[2002]] game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' established that [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] was eaten by her [[Gardulla's krayt dragon|krayt dragon]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. However, the [[2010]] episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' "[[Hunt for Ziro]]" showed Gardulla alive well into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], more than [[21 BBY/Legends|ten years later]]. [[Leland Chee]] later established that the krayt dragon found her "indigestible."<ref name="Leland tweet">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/3269273187254272|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=Gardulla's krayt dragon found her...indigestible.|archivefile=File:HolocronKeeperIndigestion.png}}</ref>
